# Hotel Cartagena Walled City

## Permanent property facts

Hotel Cartagena Walled City is in Cartagena, Colombia, in the South America region.
Facilities: Courtyard pool; rooftop bar; colonial-style suites. Pool or water-facility hours: 08:00-20:00.
Parking: Valet parking; USD 30 nightly. Transportation: Vehicle access is coordinated with the old city.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
